_comment: BESS historian policy tiers: critical 1-second data for 3 months, 1-minute for 1 year, 5-minute for 5 years, and 15-minute for 12 years. Day-based approximations are used; the archive manager operates on monthly partitions. This config does not implement backups, legal holds, or event-record retention.

tiers.name: raw_1s
tiers.description: Critical 1-second data; 3 months approximated as 90 days, with no additional safety buffer

tiers.name: raw_1m
tiers.description: 1-minute EMS metrics; 1 year approximated as 365 days, with no additional safety buffer

tiers.name: rollup_5m
tiers.description: 5-minute aggregated metrics; 5 years approximated as 1825 days, with no additional safety buffer

tiers.name: rollup_15m
tiers.description: 15-minute aggregated metrics; 12 years approximated as 4380 days, with no additional safety buffer
